title: Paramount to adapt Cyberpunk 2077 into live-action film
title_zh: 派拉蒙要把《赛博朋克2077》拍成真人电影了

lead: Paramount Pictures is developing a live-action movie based on the blockbuster video game Cyberpunk 2077, teaming up with producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura and the game's developer, CD Projekt Red. Casting, plot and release date remain under wraps.

paragraphs: Paramount Pictures is pressing ahead with a live-action adaptation of Cyberpunk 2077, the sci-fi role-playing game that has sold upwards of 40 million copies despite a notoriously troubled launch in 2020. The studio is collaborating with Lorenzo di Bonaventura, whose credits include the Transformers franchise, and with CD Projekt Red (CDPR), the Polish developer behind the game. CDPR's joint-chief executive, Michał Nowakowski, said the company was "excited about Paramount as a future partner who shares our creative ambitions for the Cyberpunk franchise".

Details concerning the film's narrative, casting and potential release window have yet to surface. The game itself stars Keanu Reeves as Johnny Silverhand, a rockstar-turned-terrorist whose consciousness is stored on a chip implanted in the body of the protagonist, V. Set in Night City, a fictional metropolis in a dystopian California, the plot revolves around a conspiracy involving the unscrupulous Arasaka megacorporation. An expansion, Phantom Liberty, featuring Idris Elba, arrived in 2023 and has notched up more than 15 million sales.

Cyberpunk has already been successfully translated to the small screen: the animated series Edgerunners proved a hit, with a second season slated to premiere on Netflix later this month. The streamer also produced The Witcher, adapted from CDPR's hugely popular fantasy series; it originally starred Henry Cavill, who was subsequently replaced by Liam Hemsworth in the fourth season.

Recent years have witnessed a flurry of video-game adaptations, with more in the pipeline. Two Super Mario movies, a big-screen Minecraft and a run of Sonic the Hedgehog films have each grossed roughly $1bn worldwide. HBO turned PlayStation's The Last of Us into a ratings success, while Prime Video describes its Fallout adaptation as one of its most-watched programmes. Microsoft, meanwhile, has unveiled a new "XP" division dedicated to licensing its games for films, theme parks and other tie-ins.
paragraphs_zh: 派拉蒙影业正在推进《赛博朋克2077》的真人电影改编。这款科幻角色扮演游戏尽管在2020年发售时麻烦不断，销量却已突破4000万份。片方将与洛伦佐·迪·博纳文图拉合作，他曾参与《变形金刚》系列；同时合作的还有游戏开发商、波兰公司CD Projekt Red（CDPR）。CDPR联席首席执行官米哈乌·诺瓦科夫斯基表示，公司“很期待派拉蒙成为未来的合作伙伴，它与我们对《赛博朋克》系列的创作抱负不谋而合”。
关于影片剧情、选角和可能的上映时间，目前尚无消息。游戏本身由基努·里维斯饰演摇滚明星出身的恐怖分子约翰尼·银手，他的意识被储存在一枚芯片里，植入主角V的体内。故事发生在夜之城——一座虚构的大都会，位于反乌托邦版的加利福尼亚，剧情围绕牵扯到不择手段的荒坂巨型企业的阴谋展开。2023年推出的资料片《往日之影》由伊德瑞斯·艾尔巴出演，销量已超过1500万份。
《赛博朋克》此前已成功搬上小荧幕：动画剧集《边缘行者》大获成功，第二季定于本月晚些时候在Netflix首播。该流媒体平台还制作了改编自CDPR超人气奇幻系列的《猎魔人》；该剧最初由亨利·卡维尔主演，第四季中他的位置被利亚姆·海姆斯沃斯取代。
近年来游戏改编作品层出不穷，还有更多项目在路上。两部《超级马力欧》电影、一部《我的世界》大电影以及一系列《刺猬索尼克》影片，全球票房均达到约10亿美元。HBO把PlayStation游戏《最后生还者》打造成热门剧集，Prime Video则称其《辐射》改编剧是最受欢迎的节目之一。与此同时，微软公布了一个新的“XP”部门，专门负责将旗下游戏授权给电影、主题公园及其他周边项目。

title_original: Video game Cyberpunk 2077 to get live-action movie adaptation
summary_original: The smash hit from the studio behind The Witcher series is to be turned into a film by Paramount Pictures.
body_original:
Video game Cyberpunk 2077 to get live-action movie adaptation
By
Tom Richardson
BBC Newsbeat
Published
9 October 2026
A live-action movie version of smash hit video game Cyberpunk 2077 is being developed by Paramount Pictures.
The Hollywood studio is working with producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura, known for his work on the Transformers films, and CD Projekt Red (CDPR), the developer of the sci-fi role-playing game.
CDPR's joint-chief executive Michał Nowakowski said in a statement
,
external
the company was "excited about Paramount as a future partner who shares our creative ambitions for the Cyberpunk franchise".
Details of the film's story, potential release date and casting information are yet to be revealed.
Despite
a troubled launch in 2020
, the Cyberpunk 2077 video game, which stars Keanu Reeves, has sold more than 40 million copies worldwide.
The John Wick star plays rockstar Johnny Silverhand, a terrorist whose consciousness is stored on a chip inside the body of main character V.
Set in Night City, a fictional metropolis in a dystopian version of California, players work to uncover a conspiracy involving the shady Arasaka megacorporation.
An expansion, Phantom Liberty,
starring Idris Elba was released in 2023
and has sold more than 15 million copies, according to CDPR.
Cyberpunk has already been successfully adapted into a popular animated series - Edgerunners - with a second season due to premiere on Netflix later this month.
The streamer also produced The Witcher, an adaptation of CDPR's massively popular fantasy role-playing series.
It originally starred former Superman actor Henry Cavill, but he was
replaced by Liam Hemsworth in the show's fourth season.
Multiple video game series have been adapted for TV and film in recent years, with more due to follow.
Two Super Mario movies, a big screen version of Minecraft and a series of Sonic the Hedgehog films have each seen global box office takings of about $1bn.
PlayStation game The Last of Us was made into a hit series by HBO, and Prime Video says its adaptation of post-apocalyptic role-playing series Fallout is one of its most-watched programmes.
Xbox maker Microsoft announced this week
,
external
it had created a new "XP" division to focus on licensing its games for films, theme parks and other tie-ins.
Earlier this week, Paramount Skydance completed
its $110bn (£82.8bn) merger
with Warner Bros Discovery.
It's promised to release 30 films annually for the next two years, but also prompted
fears over job losses and price rises for streaming services
such as HBO Max and Paramount+.
Additional reporting by Peter Gillibrand.
